channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: This California reptile closed down a Mojave Desert haven for off-road racing
item.description: The Bureau of Land Management was ordered to close down popular off-roading trails in parts of the Mojave in order to protect the imperiled desert tortoise.

item.title: After shedding pressure, American Alysa Liu rides wave of joy to Olympic gold medal
item.description: U.S. figure skater Alysa Liu smiled through a monster free program, clinching the figure skating gold medal at the Winter Olympics in Milan on Thursday.

item.title: New Mexico reopens investigation into alleged illegal activity at Epstein's former Zorro Ranch
item.description: Atty. Gen. Raúl Torrez’s office made the announcement Thursday, saying the decision was made after reviewing information recently released by the U.S. Department of Justice.

item.title: Guthrie investigators turn to Mexico, genealogy, pacemaker amid fears the trail is going cold
item.description: Authorities insist the case is still very much active, with the FBI receiving more than 19,000 tips. But the case is branching off into some new directions.

item.title: Caltech astrophysicist fatally shot on porch of his rural SoCal home, where he studied the stars
item.description: An accomplished Caltech astrophysicist with more than four decades of research contributions in galactic astronomy and the study of distant planets was fatally shot in the Antelope Valley.

item.title: Billionaires Spielberg, Zuckerberg eyeing East Coast, stirring concerns about California's wealth-tax proposal
item.description: Filmmaker Steven Spielberg recently moved to Manhattan and Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg is eyeing property in South Florida as a labor union tries to place a wealth tax on the November ballot in California.

item.title: Why Irvine police are sounding the alarm on 'senior assassin,' a popular high school tradition
item.description: The game “senior assassin,” in which high school students shoot one another with water guns, can be risky if the water guns look real, police said.

item.title: Eric Dane, Dr. McSteamy of 'Grey's Anatomy' and 'Euphoria' star, dies of ALS at 53
item.description: Actor Eric Dane, best known for wooing 'Grey's Anatomy' audiences as plastic surgeon Dr. Mark 'McSteamy' Sloan, died after a public battle with ALS. He was 53.

item.title: More rain and frosty temperatures. Here's when the storms will end
item.description: Since Monday, a series of storms has drenched much of California and dumped feet of snow in the Sierra.

item.title: Mothers, adventurers: 6 victims of Tahoe avalanche are ID'd by families 'devastated beyond words'
item.description: The women who were caught in the deadly avalanche Tuesday north of Lake Tahoe were a close group of friends, all mothers, who loved to spend time in the mountains.
